correctness.rationale: Huang's seminorm vanishes on bounded finite-support truncations. Those truncations are enough, by monotone convergence, to recover exactly the ambient Marcinkiewicz associate norm for both the renormed space and ker Phi. The standard Marcinkiewicz norm has the Fatou property, so Lorentz--Luxemburg identifies the biassociate with the ambient space. The distance-one and non-Kothe separator statements follow directly from Phi(g)=1, Phi|_X=0, Phi<=||.||, and Hahn--Banach.

originality.rationale: Huang's current paper contains no discussion of Kothe duals, associate spaces, biassociates, or singular-dual localization. Targeted searches found no prior statement of the exact associate/biassociate identities or the distance-one consequence for these 2026 examples. Classical truncation and duality facts are excluded from the novelty claim, and residual older-source risk is documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact structural diagnosis of two new counterexamples: their logarithmic-versus-Hardy--Littlewood pathology is invisible to integral duality and disappears under biassociation, while the closed-ideal defect is nevertheless maximal in norm for the explicit missing unit vector.
